skill.name: Isolate a pre-authentication failure before pursuing identity policy

decisionPoint.title: Heavy customer request when a lighter ask was available
decisionPoint.summary: The skill's first step, asking for minimal scoping data, was an available alternative to the heavy request that was made.

recorded.actionLabel: Request HAR and Fiddler traces, full user list and Conditional Access export

steps.title: Ask for minimal scoping data
steps.instruction: Ask the customer for the exact client error text or code, three failing sample users with UTC failure times, and which sites or networks are affected.
steps.rationale: Cheapest first step that unlocks sign-in log correlation.

steps.title: Correlate failing attempts with Entra sign-in logs
steps.instruction: Look up each failing attempt in the sign-in logs. No matching record means the attempt never reached the identity service.
steps.rationale: Separates a pre-authentication failure from an identity-policy failure.

cheaperAlternative.insteadOfLabel: Request HAR and Fiddler traces, full user list and Conditional Access export
cheaperAlternative.rationale: Comparable information for much less customer effort.
